milestone.piece: Explicit fresh coverage whole-source and exact-subrange selections
milestone.invariant: Fresh coverage may select complete original words without guessing offsets, but code must validate the offered shape and source identity before deriving canonical exact ranges. Selection cannot weaken original support, admitted representation, source-purpose or ownership checks, or alter historical reconstruction.
milestone.observable_pass: Opt-in native_extents offers whole_source or bounded exact_subrange under each original source. Whole selections resolve to its complete saved words; exact selections preserve their endpoints. Unknown, contradictory, unowned or malformed selections refuse with source/range feedback. Both forms yield the same existing canonical contract and support checks; default and historical paths remain unchanged.

Tests include all disposition kinds, mixed/overlapping portions, non-account empty portions, actual saved/candidate support, empty catalogues, long original words and malformed IDs. No new public browser or pinned-model calls: this shared contract is a prerequisite, not complete coverage-feature acceptance.
